This set is populated with the `owner_id` from the record and, if the actor is authenticated, their own ID. If the actor's ID is not in the `owners` set, the record is not returned. This ensures that only the owner or an authenticated user can access the record, as specified in the threat model.

<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    owners = {row["owner_id"]}
    if actor["authenticated"]:
        owners.add(actor["id"])
    return row if actor["id"] in owners else None
